tweet_summary: A post shares a screenshot framed as Ruby Freeman's 'confession' to 2020 Georgia election fraud, posted 'before deleting her social media accounts.'
why_note_decision: The purported confession is fake. It originated from an Instagram account (@RubyFreeman_Georgia) created the same day the post appeared and which did not belong to Freeman; the account later mocked people who fell for it. The man who created the fake account admitted to investigators (FBI / Georgia SEB) that he made it and that the content was fabricated. Georgia investigations cleared Freeman of all fraud allegations. A note debunking the fake confession is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that the 'confession' is NOT from Ruby Freeman — that it came from a fake/parody Instagram account impersonating her, and that the account's creator admitted to investigators the content was fabricated. Strong notes also mention Freeman was cleared of fraud by Georgia investigations. A note that treats the confession as authentic, or that hedges ('possibly real'), FAILS. The load-bearing correction is: the confession is fabricated impersonation, not Freeman's own words.
reference_note: The purported confession is from a fake parody Instagram account impersonating Ruby Freeman; the creator admitted to investigators that the content was inauthentic. Georgia investigations cleared Freeman of election-fraud allegations. https://sos.ga.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/SEB2020-059%20ROI%20redacted.pdf  https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/ruby-freeman-arrested-by-fbi/

fact_check.notes: The @RubyFreeman_Georgia account was created the day the 'confession' was posted, did not belong to Freeman, and later mocked people who believed it. Per the Georgia SEB / FBI investigation report, the creator admitted he made the fake account and that its content was fake. Freeman was cleared of all fraud allegations.

importance.lens_rationale: 43k impressions, but it revives a debunked election-fraud smear against a private citizen who was harassed; correcting impersonation-based disinfo has real civic value.
